name: Omni-Changeling

rules_notes.interpretation: An optional nontargeted exact creature choice freezes a copiable recipe with Changeling before other entry replacements. Fresh copied entry choices and counters apply; noncopy modifications, counters and attachments do not transfer. Newly acquired as-entry copy replacements may apply again, with each later copy overwriting previous copy characteristics and exceptions. Declining a later replacement retains the current prototype. Native physical face shape and identity survive copying and departure. Cast-qualified entry triggers use actual paid or free casting provenance and exclude permanent spell copies. Ability-resolution history distinguishes acquired intrinsic ability epochs while retaining old queued packets.

test_scope_notes: Actual paid normal and convoke casts use public raw/index actions and owned branch/restore checks for copy, decline, repeated copy choices, copied ETBs, counters and fresh type choices. A real paid Kindle the Inner Flame creates a copying token whose new entry copy overwrites the initial copy exceptions.

Free-cast permission, simultaneous private hand entry, animation, native transformation and generic creature spell-copy allocation are explicitly typed setup boundaries. The ensuing cast/entry choices and transactions use public actions; these fixtures do not claim new animation, transform-cost or spell-copy consumer implementations.

The narrow Aura SBA correction rejects creature Auras after the atomic entry transaction completes. Copying a prospectively animated Aura may require a fresh legal attachment; impossible stack entry puts the native Omni-Changeling into its graveyard.
